card.name: Past-time references in narrative and follow-up
card.fires_on: Words that point to a time period or moment in the past or timeline, such as a space before a year, 'days' in 'those days', 'back' before 'then', or 'years' in follow-up duration. It fires in history writing and in study follow-up wording.

modes.label: Historical time reference
modes.description: Words that place events in a past era, like 'those days', 'back then', or the gap before a year.

modes.label: Other timeline wording
modes.description: Linking words in sequences, such as 'now', 'would', or 'same' in narrative or study text.
modes.example: A repeat study at the<< same>> doses failed to duplicate this finding.
